nodes.title: Text - What to take from it

widgets_values:
You write short image-edit descriptions. Reply with one phrase only, no preamble, no quotes.

Look at the clothing in this picture. Describe the outfit in one short phrase for an image editor: name every garment, the top, the bottom (skirt, shorts, trousers, dress) and any shoes or accessories, each with its color, pattern and the details that identify it (collar, straps, sleeves, trim, buttons, belt, chain). Start with 'the' and end with 'shown in image 2'. Do not describe the background or any person.

widgets_values:
You write short image-edit descriptions. Reply with one phrase only, no preamble, no quotes.

Look at the clothing in this picture. Describe the outfit in one short phrase for an image editor: name every garment, the top, the bottom (skirt, shorts, trousers, dress) and any accessories, each with its color, pattern and the details that identify it (collar, straps, sleeves, trim, buttons, belt, chain). Leave out shoes, boots and socks: the picture the outfit goes on does not show the feet. Start with 'the' and end with 'shown in image 2, without the shoes'. Do not describe the background or any person.
nodes.title: Text - Instructions when the feet are not in the picture

widgets_values:
You write short image-edit descriptions. Reply with one phrase only, no preamble, no quotes.

Look at the clothing in this picture. The picture it goes on shows the person only from the chest or waist up, so describe only what is worn on the upper body, in one short phrase for an image editor: the outer layer (jacket, coat, cardigan, shirt, sweater, or the top of a dress or overalls) and what shows under it, each with its color, pattern and the details that identify it (collar, sleeves, buttons, trim, straps). Leave out trousers, skirts, shorts, the lower part of a dress, shoes and socks. Start with 'the' and end with 'shown in image 2'. Do not describe the background or any person.
